summary.text: Cyrus Javadi is a Democratic state representative from District 32 who has represented the district since January 9, 2023 and is seeking re-election.
He appears on the November 3, 2026 ballot with Democratic and Independent Party of Oregon nominations.

paragraphs.text: Cyrus Javadi was born in Provo, Utah, and lives in Tillamook, Oregon.
